I want to know about the contribution made by Albert Einstein on the date of 1905-05-14 in the field of Physics. Lastly, I'm working on a music project and need to calculate the duration between two notes. The first note has a frequency of 440 Hz and the second note has a frequency of 880 Hz. The tempo of the music is 100 beats per minute. Could you provide me with the results of these calculations?"
